entry.positive_observation: The final derivative preserves the approved yellow mascot, dark brows, restrained mouth, cap with principal insignia and braid, mottled fur collar, decorated black collar tabs and neck cross. The source-compatible pose, direct gaze, crop and pale complete photographic backplate remain without a replacement background or extra person.
entry.alpha_decision: Accept for production pending the separate formal import. RGB is identical to the approved parent and output alpha exactly equals the BILINEAR-resized source alpha. The source is fully opaque (all 32760 alpha pixels are 255), and all 4205568 output alpha pixels are 255; all four source, resized and output corners are 255. Full white/cyan/alpha inspection shows intact opaque backing and clothing without visible holes or exterior halo.
entry.visible_limitations: The exact fine fur texture and small heraldic details cannot be established microscopically from the 156x210 source. Approval covers the visible features, clothing, collar, composition and opaque backing; it does not claim exact reconstruction of unreadable insignia.
